# dbader.org

> > Dan Bader's Python training platform offering comprehensive tutorials, courses, and career guidance for developers at all skill levels.

dbader.org is a Python education resource created by Dan Bader featuring structured learning paths from beginner fundamentals through intermediate mastery, along with career development guidance for Python developers. The site emphasizes pythonic code practices, professional development, and real-world application skills.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Python Basics
- Beginner Guide
- Intermediate Developer
- Python Training
- Skill Development
- Career Growth
- Professional Development
- Pythonic Code
- Learning Roadmap
- Python Career
- Mentorship
- Django
- Data Science
- Job Market

## Getting Started with Python

- [How can I learn the basics of Python?](https://dbader.org/python-basics): Beginner guide to Python fundamentals and learning roadmap for getting started.
- [Switching to Python from another programming language](https://dbader.org/switching-to-python): Guide for developers switching from C++, C#, Java, JavaScript to Python.

## Skill Development & Learning

- [How do I take my Python skills to the next level?](https://dbader.org/python-intermediate): Guide to intermediate Python skills, best practices, and web development with Flask.
- [Python Training by Dan Bader](https://dbader.org): Dan Bader's Python training platform with tutorials, videos, and courses for developers.

## Career Development

- [Building a successful Python career](https://dbader.org/start-python-career): Career guide covering Python skills, Django, Data Science, and job market insights.
- [Growing your Python career](https://dbader.org/grow-python-career): Professional development guide for advancing Python careers and mentorship.

## Community & Resources

- [Dan's Python Newsletter: Weekly Tips for Python Devs](https://dbader.org/newsletter): Weekly Python newsletter with tips and tricks delivered to developer inboxes.
